title: Shelf-life countdown on an e-ink label
abstract: Compute remaining shelf life from the logged temperature history with a decay model.
description: Compute remaining shelf life from the logged temperature history with a decay model. Show the remaining days on an e-ink label printed onto the carton. Refresh the e-ink label whenever the remaining shelf life drops by a day.

claims.text: A method comprising: compute remaining shelf life from the logged temperature history with a decay model; show the remaining days on an e-ink label printed onto the carton; refresh the e-ink label whenever the remaining shelf life drops by a day.
